text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp.
At lodge, wracking brain over script——

Promo proposal sheet sat blank on desk.
Reason I tackled this solo started
earlier——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Shooting special promo feature!
"Royce-chan's Summer Vacation VOD"!
Taking Royce brand worldwide!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Handing you creative control, Trainer.
Producer, director, camera operator
——Complete package!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You.
——Shooting starts next scheduled break!
Understood?

Royce and Royce entrusted entire project to me.
Needed plan that exceeded expectations.

Required familiar angle…
Spotlight hidden charm from unexpected
perspective.
choice_data_list: Let me give her profile another read!

text_block_list.text: Shoot day arrived——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Ultimate Time & Cost Efficiency!
Royce and Royce's Guide to Perfect Countryside
Summer"——
choice_data_list: I figured we'd play to your strengths.
I figured we'd play to your strengths.

text_block_list.text:
Countryside pace: slow,
opposite of efficient.
Highlighting efficiency against rural backdrop
created stark, compelling contrast.
choice_data_list: This script'll really make you shine!
This script'll really make you shine!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Understood. Executing this concept.
choice_data_list: Huh? You don't have any feedback?
Huh? You don't have any feedback?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Remember instructions:
You run creative direction!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Opening take up first.
Tone for delivery?

Normally rustic location calls for relaxed
tone.
But concept showcases high-energy efficiency,
so——
choice_data_list: Focus on efficiency from the very ...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Hey everyone!
Time for summer fun with your girl Royce-chan
in nature♪"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! Oh nooo～!
Mountain daylight runs out super fast!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Zero time to waste!
Hurry, hurryyy～!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Crisp water～!
…Plan says 'river playtime'.
What's next action?

Rafting and fishing gear too cost-inefficient.
Needed zero-cost activity using found
resources——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Wooow! Gorgeous stream～!
Must-do activity at stream like this——"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Leaf boat Grand Prix!
Materials sourced 100% locally from surrounding
forest!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-daaa! Vessel complete!
Naming her Phantom EX Edition!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Branch outriggers give maximum stability.
Hydrodynamic leaf hull minimizes drag.
Engineered purely for raw speed♪"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Position in calm water pocket, then…
Ready… set…"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"GO!
…Yes! Clean launch!
Full throttle to finish line!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaaa～～♡
Too fast, Phantom EX Edition!"
Shooting progressed smoothly——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Final segment: local festival speed-run,
then climax outro——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Full throttle!
Wrapping summer tour on high note♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"What you've all been waiting for!
Festival mode Royce-chan, live on scene!☆"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Pro tip:
festival stalls are race against clock.
Royce-chan shows how to clear maximum fun
at minimum time♪"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Target spotted! Multi-food vendor!
One order takoyaki, okonomiyaki,
and yakisoba combo, please♪"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"One-stop bulk purchase saves walking
time!
More time for attractions!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Shooting gallery trick: high-cadence spray.
'Bang! Bang!
Got it? Missed? Next!' …Efficiency key!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Shaved ice tastes best crunchy before melt!
Prevent brain freeze by keeping ice off
palate roof——"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"～～～～!
S-See? Zero problem～"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Captured strong profile.
Script suited my style well.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Right, setting up outro——
(Crack-boom……… Ba-bang!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Heehee. Ended up with best seats in house.

Fireworks light illuminated her face softly.
Pointed camera reflexively——
…Then hesitated.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hm? Camera stopped?

Video core theme: strict efficiency.
Gazing quietly at fireworks was charming,
but clashed with project concept.
choice_data_list: It'd throw off the whole script, so…

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm…
I see.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
…Personal impression, then?
Do fireworks suit me?
choice_data_list: …I think you look amazing that way.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Valid enough.
Entrusted shoot to 'you', after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Feel, don't overthink.
Record me through YOUR lens…
…Agreed?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Phew～ Today was so much fun.
We made so many summer memories in just one
day♪"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"And to top it all off… Look!
We enjoyed ourselves so efficiently,
we were right on time for the fireworks!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"See what happens when you bet on
Royce-chan?
——Ehehe♡
That's all for today. See you next time～!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Whew! And cut!
That's another step on my journey to the
top!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Can I keep counting on you from here on out,
Trainer?

Making her the greatest is my dream as her
trainer.
Answer needed no hesitation——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Aren't you being a bit cold～?
What I'm really trying to say is——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I want to spend way more time with you♡

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Did your heart just skip a beat?
Looks like my win.
…Just kidding.

Wished I could've recorded her impish smile,
a log of our shared journey to the summit.
A journey only just beginning.
